subject: Request: 2hr deep-dive window for cross-region marketplace PoC with SkyLens SI
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skylens.io>, Marcus Lee <m.lee@skylens.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 2hr deep-dive window for cross-region marketplace PoC with SkyLens SI

Hi Alex / Marcus —

Thanks again for the alignment last week. We want to run a focused PoC deep-dive that walks through:
- multi-tenant routing for marketplace listings (hosted vs. dedicated)
- a 2-region failover demo (us-west / eu-west) with traffic shaping
- integration checklist for SkyLens SI (roles, artifacts, and expected timelines)

This will be a technical, 2-hour working session rather than a product overview. Redwood will provide a short agenda and a minimal test harness. Can you share availability for a 2-hour block next week (Mon–Thu)? Prefer windows that work for both EU and US participants (e.g., 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PDT or 08:00 UTC / 17:00 SGT).

I've attached a draft agenda and a CSV of suggested attendees/roles. If you want us to lead the failover demo, we can — otherwise please nominate a SkyLens tech lead who will drive the SI-side steps.

Key asks:
- Two candidate 2-hour windows (include time zone)
- Tech lead contact full name and email
- Any restrictions for lab/test accounts or IP whitelisting we should provision ahead of time

Thanks — looking to lock this early so we can send calendar invites and run a short preflight.

Best,
Olga
Director, Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: agenda_skylens_poc_v1.pdf (PDF), redwood-demo-roles.csv (CSV)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@skylens.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <m.lee@skylens.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2hr deep-dive window for cross-region marketplace PoC with SkyLens SI

Thanks Olga — this sounds good.

We can commit to two candidate slots:
- Tues 27 Jun, 16:00–18:00 UTC (09:00–11:00 PDT)
- Wed 28 Jun, 08:00–10:00 UTC (16:00–18:00 SGT)

Marcus (cc'd) will be the SI tech lead on our side and will drive the SkyLens steps. Marcus, do you need any specific infra access ahead of time? We can open a temporary service account and IP allowlist for the demo if Redwood provides the target endpoints.

Also tagging procurement for a quick note — if there are any billing or PoC paperwork items we should get in place before the deep-dive, please flag them.

Appreciate it — Alex
Partnerships, SkyLens

Confirmed: I can lead on the SkyLens side. We prefer Tue 27 Jun 16:00–18:00 UTC.

Infra asks from our side:
- A short preflight runbook with endpoints + temp service account credentials at least 48 hours ahead

Olga / Vanessa — can we also nominate a Redwood co-host who will own the failover toggle during the demo? I'd like a single point of contact to avoid cross-talk.

Olga — I'll co-host the failover toggle and coordinate the infra handoff. Vivek, Jonas — please standby for the preflight (48h). Vivek, can you prepare the demo route map and the temporary service account? Jonas, please prepare a 10-minute monitoring dashboard primer to run at the start of the session.

Vanessa
